lines.en: Ten health — one strike is enough.
Tracks footsteps
I close in along the base of the wall.
Advances cautiously
I do not chase; I wait right here.
Stares at the ground
Sharp gaze shifts
Tail the target
I'll make a sound first, to turn your head.
I creep forward an inch at a time.
I measure every step you take.
I shift silently between the bone heaps.

lines.zh: 聚集地很静，正适合伏击。
lines.en: The gathering is quiet. Good for ambush.
Stares into the dark
Whispers to itself
Curls up tighter
At the settlement's edge, I slowly squirm.
Gazes into the distance

lines.zh: 我只有十点血，一击就够重。
lines.en: Ten health, and one hit lands heavy.
Breathes heavily
Mumbles quietly

lines.zh: 我蹲在聚集地，等一次六十八点的伏击。
lines.en: I crouch in the settlement for one sixty-eight-point ambush.
Ten points of life under this thin skin.
I count every breath in this cave.
The wind of the Flesh Plains washes over me.
I wait for the moment your back is turned.
I do not blink; I only watch you.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我就近一格。
lines.en: Every step you take, I close one square.
Focuses gaze
Observes carefully

lines.zh: 我算好了扑过去的距离。
lines.en: I have measured the distance to lunge.

lines.zh: 我只剩十点生命，一击却够你躺下。
lines.en: Ten health, but one hit lays you out.
I am weighing your pack by its sway.
This hit lands sixty-eight; don't test it.
My gaze is pinned to your back.
I watch you from beside the door frame.
Half my face shows from behind the bones.
I memorize the rhythm of your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 你转头时我已换了位置
lines.en: When you turn, I have already moved.
My eyes do not blink once in the dark.

lines.zh: 你的影子先拐进了巷口。
lines.en: Your shadow rounded the alley first.
Three steps, two, and still you walk.
I watch you across the Flesh Plains.
Only one eye is left in the rock crack.
I hear every breath you take.
I slowly tilt my head to one side.
A chill runs through you...
Light dances in your eyes...
You feel its gaze...
Your heart races...
Fear surrounds you...
You hear its whisper...
Its presence makes you shiver...
Severe pain sears through you...
You cannot move...
You hear its breath...

lines.zh: 你靠近得太近了，察觉者注意到了你。
lines.en: You got too close. The watcher noticed.

lines.zh: 阴影中传来低沉的嘶嘶声，追踪者来了。
lines.en: A low hiss from the shadows. The stalker is here.

lines.zh: 远处的追踪者正窥视着。
lines.en: A stalker is watching from afar.
You have its prey on you.

lines.zh: 追踪者用寒冷的眼神盯着你。
lines.en: The stalker stares at you with cold eyes.
That little light tightens my throat.

lines.zh: 追踪者的身影如影随形。
lines.en: The stalker's shadow follows you.
It waits for the right moment.
Its sense is drawn to you.
The stalker approaches silently.

lines.zh: 你撞上了追踪者的视线。
lines.en: You met the stalker's gaze.
The stalker passed by you.
You bumped into it.

lines.zh: 追踪者挡住了你的去路。
lines.en: The stalker blocked your path.

lines.zh: 它似乎察觉了你的意图。
lines.en: It sensed your intentions.
The stalker loitered nearby.

lines.zh: 你们在黑暗中擦肩而过。
lines.en: You brushed past it in the dark.

lines.zh: 你和追踪者撞了个满怀。
lines.en: You and the stalker collided.

lines.zh: 追踪者突然出现阻止你。
lines.en: The stalker appeared to stop you.
You passed by the stalker.
The stalker searches for a mate.

lines.zh: 追踪者对同类充满好奇。
lines.en: The stalker is curious about its kind.

lines.zh: 追踪者发出求偶的嘶鸣。
lines.en: The stalker calls for a mate.

lines.zh: 它寻找着可以交配的对象。
lines.en: It looks for a partner.

lines.zh: 追踪者在孤独中渴望交流。
lines.en: The stalker craves connection in solitude.

lines.zh: 它对同类的叫声作出反应。
lines.en: It responds to its kind's call.

lines.zh: 追踪者开始寻找交配机会。
lines.en: The stalker seeks mating opportunities.

lines.zh: 我只有十点血，一击就够。
lines.en: I have ten health, and one hit is enough.

lines.zh: 追踪者对同类表现出兴趣。
lines.en: The stalker shows interest in its kind.
It awaits a meeting with its kind.
Sssss... Something here!
You moved... I'm watching!
The scent of food... Nice.
Good hiding spot here.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我看见你了。
lines.en: You can't escape me. I saw you.

lines.zh: 追踪者的猎物，我的食物。
lines.en: The prey of a stalker. My meal.
Be still... Prey is near.

lines.zh: 这地方藏得很深，不会被发现。
lines.en: Deep cover... Won't be found.
Too close... Watch out.
I pick up the ration you dropped.
Target acquired. Wait for the right moment.
It moves... Get closer.
Its scent... Weak.
You entered the settlement I watch.
That patch of shadow by your feet is me.
Get closer, don't scare it.

lines.zh: 它在呼吸，小心它的攻击。
lines.en: It breathes... Be careful.
Don't let it sense you.

lines.zh: 等待它的失误，抓住机会。
lines.en: Wait for its mistake. Take the chance.
It's letting its guard down... Now!
You are alone. Now.

lines.zh: 一次就够了，我只需一击
lines.en: One strike is all I need.
I press my breathing down to nothing.
I follow the prints you left.
The smell of flesh never lies.
My legs coil, ready to spring.
One strike. It lands heavy.
Attack its head.

lines.zh: 我只有十点血，一击却够。
lines.en: Ten points of health, and one hit is enough.
Be careful, its fangs.
Hit its heart... End it.
Keep your distance... Don't get close.
Distract it, take the chance.
It's fast... Be careful.
Its attack is strong... Be careful.
I arch my back and wait for you to turn.
There is no armor on the back of your neck.
Two more steps. Just two.
I circle to your flank.
I watch the instant you lift your foot.
I hide my fangs in the shadow.
Bone dust crumbles under my claws.
I wait until you lower your torch.
One leap, and your life ends.
First I cut off your retreat.
I creep along the ground toward you.
One blow from me goes straight through.
Move in the shadows.
Your footsteps are loud.

lines.zh: 一次够重，你不必再挨第二下。
lines.en: One hit is heavy enough; no second needed.
Feel my presence.
I've waited long for this strike.

lines.zh: 你动了吗？我这眼睛不会眨。
lines.en: Did you move? My eyes never blink.
Silent hunting.
You have no way out!
Sixty-eight damage. One hit is all.
I bite the back of your neck!
I land on you without a sound!
Under this thin hide is pure spite!
Claws first, teeth right after!
Bones crack inside my mouth!
You will not even have time to shout!
Wait in the dark...
Shadows of settlements...
I take shape beneath the settlement lamps.
Silent surveillance...
Nighttime hunt...
I crouch on the beam and wait for night.
Tracking your footsteps...
Hiding in the dark...
Waiting to prey...
Waiting for the perfect moment...
I open my eyes in a corner of the gathering place.
One more shadow on the Bone Wastes.
I crawl out of the Flesh Plains.
A thin layer of skin wraps my bones.
Ten points of health. Enough for one life.
I rise against the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我在这里只等一次机会
lines.en: I'm here for one strike only
That breathing you hear is not the wind.
I wake outside your camp.
Another ambush is about to begin.
Flames sear your skin...
You fall off a cliff...
Water engulfs you...
Explosion tears your body...
Arrow pierces your body...
Magic freezes your blood...
Hunger consumes your soul...
Lightning strikes you...
You fall into the void...
